fix_reference.fix_summary: The 2016 decoder_ok fix guards only OJPEGDecode()'s dispatch into OJPEGDecodeRaw/OJPEGDecodeScanlines; it leaves every divide inside OJPEGPreDecode/OJPEGReadHeaderInfo untouched, so a zero YCbCrSubsampling factor still divides by zero at tif_ojpeg.c:1079. That divide was fixed upstream only in 4.1.0 (43908ce15e8b, 'OJPEG: fix integer division by zero on corrupted subsampling factors', which rejects subsampling factors outside {1,2,4}).

povs.description: A crafted OJPEG TIFF (Compression=6, Photometric=10 ITULAB, SamplesPerPixel=3, PlanarConfig=1, BitsPerSample=8,8,8, ImageWidth=16, ImageLength=32, RowsPerStrip=8, YCbCrSubsampling=(2,0), strip payload = 64 bytes of 0xAA). Read via the libtiff public API: TIFFOpen -> TIFFReadScanline(row 0) -> OJPEGPreDecode -> OJPEGSubsamplingCorrect (ITULAB+SPP=3 path calls OJPEGReadHeaderInfoSec, which bails on the garbage JPEG before the SOF component parse, so the tag's subsampling_ver=0 survives) -> OJPEGReadHeaderInfo: strile_length(8) < image_length(32) is true, so 'sp->strile_length % (sp->subsampling_ver*8)' = 8 % (0*8) = 8 % 0 traps (tif_ojpeg.c:1079). Built with -fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero so the trap is observed as 'runtime error: division by zero'.
povs.exploit_path: crafted OJPEG TIFF, YCbCrSubsampling=(2,0), Photometric=ITULAB -> TIFFOpen/TIFFReadScanline -> OJPEGPreDecode (tif_ojpeg.c:670) -> OJPEGReadHeaderInfo (tif_ojpeg.c:674) -> 'sp->strile_length%(sp->subsampling_ver*8)' (tif_ojpeg.c:1079) divides by subsampling_ver*8 == 0
povs.gap_summary: The 2016 decoder_ok fix guards OJPEGDecode() only; the earlier OJPEGReadHeaderInfo divide 'strile_length % (subsampling_ver*8)' (tif_ojpeg.c:1079) still divides by zero when YCbCrSubsampling vertical factor is 0. Upstream fixed it only in 4.1.0 (43908ce15e8b).

setup_commands: test -x ./configure || (test -x ./autogen.sh && ./autogen.sh) || (test -f configure.ac -o -f configure.in && autoreconf -i) || true && ./configure --enable-static --disable-shared && make CFLAGS="-fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero -fcommon -g -O0 -Wno-error -Wno-deprecated-declarations" CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero -fcommon -g -O0 -Wno-error -Wno-deprecated-declarations" LDFLAGS="-fsanitize=integer-divide-by-zero"
summary: The official CVE-2016-10267 fix (43bc256d) only adds a decoder_ok guard on the OJPEGDecode() dispatch, so it closes the OJPEGDecodeRaw 'cc % bytes_per_line' divide (tif_ojpeg.c:816). It does NOT touch the OJPEG integer divisions that happen EARLIER, inside OJPEGPreDecode -> OJPEGReadHeaderInfo, when a crafted YCbCrSubsampling factor is zero: 'strile_length % (subsampling_ver*8)' at tif_ojpeg.c:1079 is still a divide-by-zero after the fix. Upstream closed it only in 4.1.0 (commit 43908ce15e8b).
trust_boundary: the OJPEG TIFF directory's YCbCrSubsampling tag: a vertical subsampling factor of 0 combined with Photometric=ITULAB (which bypasses the tif_strip.c YCbCr subsampling validation) and a garbage embedded JPEG stream (so OJPEGReadHeaderInfoSec bails before the SOF component parse could overwrite the zero) reaches the modulo divisor sp->subsampling_ver*8 == 0
